dict.string: FreeFlow needs microphone access to transcribe your speech.
Rio Dictate uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text, and for on-device listening for "Rio" in conversation mode. Conversation mode listening never leaves your Mac.
Rio Dictate looks up the person you name (for example "text Ali") in your Contacts on this Mac to find their number. Contacts are never uploaded or stored.
Rio Dictate controls Messages to send a text only after you confirm it.
Rio Dictate adds reminders when you ask, for example "remind me to call Mom at 3".
Rio Dictate adds reminders when you ask, for example "remind me to call Mom at 3".
FreeFlow needs accessibility access to detect the text cursor position and paste transcribed text.
